title: VTC Roles — Show — payload
description: Fetch one administrative role of a VTC by name. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

name.description: Name of the role, built-in or custom.

Response.title: VTC Roles — Show — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/roles/show/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/roles/show/0.1#response.

holders.description: Optional: the number of ACL entries currently holding this role. A count, never a list of subjects. A VTC MAY omit it where the querying party may not learn it.
